per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should prevent obvious mistakes such as scheduling conflicts and invalid enrollments by providing warnings or blocking actions.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall help the user avoid making mistakes while scheduling classes and clinicals for the nursing students.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should use familiar nursing terminology to ensure ease of use.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The verbiage used within the system shall be consistent with Standard English and the terminology of the national Nursing Community.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should allow users to complete small tasks in less than 5 seconds and generate schedules in less than 30 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The response time of general student management tasks shall take no longer than 5 seconds and the response time of schedule generation shall take no longer than 30 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should handle peak loads of approximately 10 concurrent users during morning scheduling bursts.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'system shall be able to handle all of the user requests/usage during business hours.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be available 95% of the time overall, with stricter guarantees during critical windows.
The system should be available from 8 AM to 6 PM on weekdays, with overnight maintenance acceptable.
The system should follow university policies for data protection and role-based access control.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The system shall protect private information in accordance with the organization's information policy.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should allow Program Admins to edit and version curriculum structures to accommodate changes.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall be expected to manage the nursing program curriculum and class/clinical scheduling for a minimum of 5 years.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should integrate with CampusConnect for near-real-time sync of student rosters and enrollments.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The system shall interface with CampusConnect's central server'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should provide inline help and examples in forms to reduce support calls.
